scope: Independent read-only review of public framework and semantic checker only; author-owned PureStorage8 package/editorial/reference/source artifacts are excluded and are not self-certified by this review.
comparison: Working-tree framework changes against HEAD, plus new checker and targeted tests
result: No blocking correctness or contract findings; one low-priority documentation omission
specChecks: Singleton schema exemption requires both fixed oa-pure-storage-8 identity and oa-binary-search-witness checker, exactly one public case, and input exactly empty.
Formal coverage additionally requires exact exhaustive singleton oracle declaration; ordinary tasks still require a public case and at least twenty hidden cases.
Oracle coverage does not bypass the singleton declaration when 120 duplicate empty cases are supplied.
Schema independently validates expected witness; shared runtime/offline dispatcher independently validates both actual and expected. Invalid expected cannot bless a valid-looking actual output.

Witness parser validates ASCII physical three-line syntax, signed int32 values, exact declared element count and nondecreasing ordering. It accepts any matching returned index, not only the first duplicate.

Length declarations are bounded by actual array-line length before Int32Array allocation. Digit length is checked before BigInt conversion. Work and allocation are linear in bounded output bytes, not the forged declared count.

The Java simulation always finishes with right in array bounds for positive n; found versus independently scanned membership distinguishes false negatives correctly. Midpoint addition cannot overflow within the platform text-output budget.

Verify/publish/coverage/content gates retain package/source/reference/oracle/mutant fingerprint checks, normal-exit mutant requirement and source-bound semantic identity checks. No production or remote run performed during review.

tests.detail: Includes 9002 small nondecreasing array/target combinations, alternate witnesses, int32 and malformed-format checks, singleton identity and domain rejection.
Schema mutation rejection and worker/offline/shared-dispatch agreement, including invalid expected outputs.

standardsReview.lowPriorityFinding: docs/OJ.md:19 and scripts/oa-judge/README.md:15 still describe unconditional minimum public/hidden case counts. Document the source-bound singleton exception without broadening ordinary requirements.

limitations: No full build or production sandbox was run.
This record does not replace separate independent author-package review or sandbox acceptance.
